interRaterReliability: NOT MEASURED — a single reviewer. No agreement statistic is invented.
priorExposureDisclosure: The reviewer had SEEN SOME OF THESE OUTPUTS BEFORE, while hunting harness bugs in ENG-015: T014/A, T018/A, T022/A, T031/A, T040/A, and all arms of T033 and T049. method: Each criterion judged as its own proposition against the output text. No overall-impression scoring. PASS / FAIL / UNCERTAIN, where UNCERTAIN means the proposition could not be settled from the artifact and is NOT a disguised FAIL.
